context:
# Goal
Mori round15 one claim C1 coverage (lowest owned axis6 vs operability7): preserve critical OOM and user signal alarms from individually valid current-boot structured records even when an adjacent malformed/nonmatching/foreign-boot record invalidates the aggregate class. Existing raw aggregate/split counts STAY unavailable when invalid. Do not claim completeness, authenticated ids, unique victims or repair arbitrary malformed JSON. C1 sourced to reopened S014/S015/S037/S038. L1 holds planner. Other debt is unclaimed conformance.
# Shared contract
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mori-shokunin/<that path>. All path operations absolute. No fleet/sibling/MANIFEST/SHONEN/verifier/aggregator edits. Each seat owns only its assigned file plus its report; report-only seats never edit production. Leaf; no delegation/background jobs; skip all builds/tests/linters/formatters/smoke runs, L1 verifies once after integration. No commits.
Safety: never open/copy/query/modify ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or credential/auth files; never launch separate omp processes. You may install/upgrade helpful tools after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in report).
Production interface: keep every existing raw token and unavailable semantics; add per-scope validated-positive evidence tokens positive_kernel_oom, positive_unit_oom, positive_unit_signal, positive_process_sigkill. They count ONLY object records with scalar matching MESSAGE_ID and scalar current _BOOT_ID; unit result exact string oom-kill/signal; process exact killed and scalar status 9. Use same captured successful stderr-free valid JSON stream, no extra journal query. Positive fields unavailable on capture/parser failure; unsafe/nonmatching records excluded, never interpreted as numeric-zero total. OOM fires once if ANY independently valid positive OOM record exists (raw counts can remain unavailable). User KILL_SIGNAL_JOURNAL WARN likewise uses independently valid user unit-signal/process-sigkill records. Existing info owner partition remains aggregate-only unavailable. Finding fields preserve raw counts and add positive evidence; no new route/actuation.
Fixture pack schema: JSON list of case objects {id, user:[records], system:[records], want_oom:bool, want_signal:bool, invalid_class:string|null}. Use _BOOT_ID='11111111111111111111111111111111', ids kernel=fe6faa94e7774663a0da52717891d8ef, unit=d9b373ed55a64feb8242e02dbe79a49c, process=98e322203f7a4ed290d09fe03c09fe15. Case ids unique. No raw MESSAGE or secret canaries. Harness owner consumes packs under .ufo/waves/round-15/fixtures/*.json. Static expected literals independent of SUT. All fixture pack seats write 2–4 concretely distinct cases for their named edge; no execution.
milestone: retain validated positives without fabricated totals
